verdict.rationale: Secureframe's vendor risk management feature explicitly supports inventorying vendors, tracking security posture, automating shadow IT/vendor discovery via SSO, extracting security review answers from vendor docs (SOC2 reports), and setting recurring review cadences with notifications — replacing spreadsheet-based tracking. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on data-access risk classification granularity.
